name: Ostra
fantasy: The lamplighter who floats. Pulls the fight to her, then lets it fall in.
silhouette: the hovering lantern and the long trailing hem

card.role: Controller: stuns from range, drops a growing bomb on the stunned, and trades places to set it up.
card.loop: Controller: stuns from range, drops a growing bomb on the stunned, and trades places to set it up.
card.lmb: Tether Lantern: quick orbs to full range; pause and the next one is a fast bright bolt that slows.
card.rmb: Shard Snap: a short wind-up, then a bundle of shards that stuns the first foe, longer the further it flew.
card.e: Brimseed: drop a bomb at the cursor that grows for 6.5s; press again to pop it, harder the bigger it grew.
card.dash: Lantern Trade: lob a lantern to the cursor; when it lands you swap places with whoever stands there.
card.passive: Swell: your hits fill Swell (much faster on hunters); full, you are Swollen for 9s and everything grows.

weapons.tether_lantern: Quick orbs to full range; pause 1.4s and the next one is a fast bright bolt that slows.

card.x: Nightwell: from level 6, open a well at the cursor that stuns everything inside for 3.5s and draws it to the middle.

passive.name: Swell
passive.desc: Damage you deal fills Swell (ten times as fast against hunters). Full Swell makes you Swollen for 9s, wrapped in a pink sphere: your seed grows larger and faster, Trade lands sooner, your Snap hits 40% harder. A knock heals you 20% of your health.

dash.name: Lantern Trade
dash.desc: Hold Shift to see both ends, let go (or tap) to lob a lantern up to 12m to the cursor. 1.7s later you are there, keeping your height and momentum, and anyone standing in the spot is sent to where you were (foes slowed 40% for 3s). Over the abyss you land on the last solid ground. Swollen: 1.25s.

variants.tap: A 0.2s wind-up, then one tight bundle of shards to 13m. It stuns the first foe it hits, from 0.8s up to 1.8s the further it flew. Swollen: +40% damage.

e.name: Brimseed
e.desc: Drop a seed up to 9m away at the cursor (on ground, short of walls). It swells for 6.5s up to 3.2m wide, a light column rising when it is nearly full, then pops by itself; press E again (from 0.3s) to pop it sooner. Damage 12 up to 3.5 times that by how long it grew, and everyone it catches is Grounded for 1s. Swollen: larger and quicker.

x.name: Nightwell
x.desc: Tap X: a pale dome of the well's exact size appears at the cursor (up to 10m away, on ground short of walls) and everyone sees it for 1.0s. Then the well opens for 3.5s, 3.6m wide: every foe inside, or who walks in, is stunned until it closes and drawn to its middle, taking a small hit every 0.1s. Allies are untouched, and you are free to act. Swollen: 5.1m wide. 64s.

rank3.dash: allies beside you when you leave, or where you land, get a shield
rank3.kin: the seed burns foes inside while it grows

rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 11s -> 8.8s; the growing seed burns foes inside.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; allies beside you or at your landing get a 20 shield for 3s.

tells.half: a ring of teal motes closes around her
tells.full: the lantern burns white and the hem lifts
tells.dash_spent: a pale ripple where she stood
